experience.playerFantasy: You are an ordinary resident in a culturally neutral apartment community who notices small problems and helps people solve them together.
experience.emotionalPromise: Warm everyday encounters, clear consequences, and the quiet satisfaction of making a shared place easier to live in.
experience.commonKnowledgeBoundary: A present-day, internationally legible apartment community using familiar places and objects; no financial, technical, or specialist knowledge is required.
experience.openingObjective: Take the last shared umbrella from the lobby rack to a neighbor waiting at the bus stop.

fixedRules: Every public request and unique shared item has one authoritative state visible to all players.
A parcel, spare key, umbrella, or other unique item cannot be held by two players at once.
Personal relationships and private story details never become shared-world authority.
A completed, handed-off, or unavailable request must be explained in the visible story before new choices appear.
generationRules: AI may create ordinary residents, small domestic complications, weather, and neighborhood conversations.
Every turn must advance the chosen request, a personal relationship, a location, or a visible shared-world fact.
Choices must be feasible from the current location, custody state, known characters, and committed world version.
Conflicts recover in-world by refreshing the board and preserving the attempted intent when it remains possible.

choiceIntents: claim or inspect a neighborhood request
carry, return, or hand off a shared item
ask a resident for help or clarify what happened

signatureItem.ability: Carries one borrowed community key or small shared item with visible custody.
signatureItem.limitOrCost: It can hold only one shared item and must be returned or handed off before another is claimed.
signatureItem.provenance: Kept on the apartment lobby's shared shelf for residents handling community requests.

methods: ask another resident to share the task
return or hand off the held shared item
pause and choose a safer practical route
threatPalette: the elevator stops while a heavy parcel still needs delivery
rain begins flooding the entrance before the umbrella is returned
a medicine pickup becomes urgent while the intended helper is delayed
a neighbor's pet slips out while two residents are coordinating care
one spare key is needed by two open requests at the same time

visuals.artDirection: warm editorial gouache of a culturally neutral contemporary apartment community, muted paper colors, grounded anatomy, practical objects, and soft evening light
visuals.entryScene: a modest apartment lobby with a shared umbrella rack and parcel shelf as the first drops of rain appear, one folded umbrella remaining, no readable text
visuals.sceneImageDirection: grounded internationally legible neighborhood scene, culturally neutral contemporary clothing and architecture, one clear practical action, natural expressions, no UI and no readable text
visuals.itemImageDirection: quiet evidence-style still life of one everyday shared object on warm paper or wood, object only, no people, logos, labels, or readable text

audio.mood: soft neighborhood ambience, distant bicycles, door chimes, light rain, and restrained warm melodic tones

failureConsequences: a request is handed to another resident
the player loses energy or patience
a shared item must be returned before continuing
the route changes after another player acts first
